seoul-jongno.name: Jongno-gu
seoul-jongno.hours: Residential areas and back streets: 19:00–21:00 / Main roads: 22:00–01:00 (next day)
seoul-jongno.days: Depends on your lot address (지번) (e.g. Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri). Check by address with the district office's 'Disposal day search' (배출일시 검색)
seoul-jongno.place: In front of your own home or shop (general waste, food waste and recycling together, on the set days and times)
seoul-jongno.food: Put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투) (1, 2, 3 or 5 L), then in a food-waste bin with a lid, in front of your home
seoul-jongno.bulky: Apply for large household waste (대형생활폐기물) on the district office (구청) website or at the community center (동주민센터) → attach the certificate sticker (신고필증) and put it out
seoul-jongno.recyclingNotes: Clear PET bottles (투명페트병): remove the label, crush, put in a clear bag. Thursday (Sun·Tue·Thu areas) or Friday (Mon·Wed·Fri areas)

seoul-jung.name: Jung-gu
seoul-jung.hours: Residential areas: 19:00–24:00 / Main roads and special tourist zones (관광특구): 22:00–01:00 (next day)
seoul-jung.days: Every day, except the no-disposal day
seoul-jung.noPickupDay: Sogong-dong, Hoehyeon-dong, Euljiro-dong: Sunday / Jungnim, Pil, Jangchung, Gwanghui, Dasan, Sindang, Yaksu, Cheonggu, Sindang 5, Donghwa, Hwanghak-dong: Saturday / Myeong-dong: none
seoul-jung.place: In front of your own home or shop, or beside the building. Do not put it on the roadside (도로변)
seoul-jung.food: Houses: yellow food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), in front of your home. Apartments: special bin + payment sticker (납부필증) or RFID
seoul-jung.bulky: 'Bbegi' (빼기) app or website (bbegi.com), or call 1577-6731. Free pickup of large appliances: 1599-0903
seoul-jung.recyclingNotes: Plastic film/bags (비닐): separately, in a clear or semi-clear bag. Styrofoam (스티로폼): white only

seoul-yongsan.name: Yongsan-gu
seoul-yongsan.days: Sunday to Friday evenings (6 days a week from 2026)
seoul-yongsan.noPickupDay: No disposal on Saturday. Also no disposal on the day before a public holiday
seoul-yongsan.bulky: Apply for large household waste (대형생활폐기물) on the district office (구청) website
seoul-yongsan.recyclingNotes: Based on the district office's KakaoTalk channel. Please check again on the district office website

seoul-mapo.name: Mapo-gu
seoul-mapo.days: General and food waste: Sun·Mon·Tue·Wed·Thu / Recycling: clear PET bottles (투명페트병) and plastic film (비닐) on Wednesday, everything else Sun·Mon·Tue·Thu
seoul-mapo.place: In front of your own home or shop (building)
seoul-mapo.food: Houses: yellow food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), in the food-waste bin in front of your home (before 22:00 if possible)
seoul-mapo.bags: Shops with a 'garbage bag sales' sign (쓰레기봉투판매소)
seoul-mapo.bulky: smartclean.mapo.go.kr or the community center (동주민센터) → attach the sticker and put it out. Large appliances free: 1599-0903
seoul-mapo.recyclingNotes: Breaking the day/time rules: fine (과태료) of 100,000 won

seoul-gangnam.name: Gangnam-gu
seoul-gangnam.days: Mon–Fri (some notices say Sun–Fri). Recycling: Thursday is only plastic film (비닐) and clear PET bottles (투명페트병); other recycling Mon·Tue·Wed·Fri·Sun
seoul-gangnam.place: Always in front of your own home or shop
seoul-gangnam.food: Drain the water, put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용 봉투), then in the food-waste bin. Apartments with RFID: use your card
seoul-gangnam.bulky: Apply online at clean.gangnam.go.kr, or call the contractor (대행업체) 3 days before
seoul-gangnam.recyclingNotes: Houses and villas (빌라): plastic film and clear PET bottles in a clear bag / white net bag; other recycling in a green net bag

seoul-seodaemun.name: Seodaemun-gu
seoul-seodaemun.days: Depends on the neighborhood (동). Mon·Wed·Fri: Cheonyeon, Hongje 1·2·3, Hongeun 2, Namgajwa 1·2, Bukgajwa 1-dong, etc. / Tue·Thu·Sun: Bukahyeon, Yeonhui, Hongeun 1, Bukgajwa 2-dong, Sinchon-dong (Changcheon), etc.
seoul-seodaemun.place: In front of your own home or shop
seoul-seodaemun.food: Put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), then in the collection bin
seoul-seodaemun.bags: 'Sales point search' (판매소 검색) on the district website
seoul-seodaemun.bulky: Report online at sdm.go.kr or call the contractor (대행업체) → attach the certificate sticker (신고필증) and put it out
seoul-seodaemun.recyclingNotes: Clear PET bottles (투명페트병): empty, remove the label, crush, put out separately. Plastic film (비닐) only with other film, in a clear bag

seoul-gwanak.name: Gwanak-gu
seoul-gwanak.days: Every day except Saturday (plastic film and clear PET bottles: Thursday only)
seoul-gwanak.place: In front of your own home or shop
seoul-gwanak.food: Houses and villas: drain the water, put it in a food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), then in the special bin
seoul-gwanak.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제봉투) sales points (search locations on the district website). Special sacks (특수마대) at the community center (동주민센터)
seoul-gwanak.recyclingNotes: Plastic film (비닐) and clear PET bottles (투명페트병): each separately, Thursday only, in a clear or semi-clear bag. Apartments: depends on each complex

seoul-yeongdeungpo.name: Yeongdeungpo-gu
seoul-yeongdeungpo.days: Every day except Saturdays and public holidays. Clear PET bottles and plastic film: Thursday (houses and shops)
seoul-yeongdeungpo.noPickupDay: No disposal on Saturdays, public holidays, or holiday breaks (명절 연휴)
seoul-yeongdeungpo.place: Houses: in front of your own home or shop / Apartments: designated disposal spot
seoul-yeongdeungpo.food: Put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투), then in a bin near your home. RFID areas: use your card
seoul-yeongdeungpo.bags: Bag sales point near your home
seoul-yeongdeungpo.recyclingNotes: Blankets and pillows: report as large waste (대형폐기물)

gg-icheon.name: Icheon-si
gg-icheon.hours: From sunset the day before pickup until sunrise on pickup day (not in the daytime)
gg-icheon.days: Depends on the village (disposal spot). Check the timetable 'Garbage collection routes' (쓰레기 수거노선 안내) on the city website. No pickup on Sunday
gg-icheon.place: The disposal spot written in the pickup timetable
gg-icheon.bags: Only Icheon City pay-as-you-throw bags (이천시 종량제 봉투)
gg-icheon.bulky: Report first, then attach the sticker and put it out. Apply online on the city website (Resource Circulation Division 자원순환과: 031-644-2598)
gg-icheon.recyclingNotes: Put recycling in clear plastic bags or tie it with string. Broken fluorescent lamps go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투)

gg-ansan.name: Ansan-si
gg-ansan.hours: 20:00 the day before – 06:00 the next day
gg-ansan.days: General and food waste: every day (Sangnok-gu: no pickup on Sunday) / Recycling: Tue·Fri / Apartments: days set by the complex
gg-ansan.noPickupDay: Sangnok-gu: please do not put it out on Saturday
gg-ansan.place: In front of your own home or shop
gg-ansan.food: Orange food-waste bag (음식물 전용봉투), with the water drained
gg-ansan.bags: Nearby supermarket or convenience store (questions: Ansan Urban Corporation 안산도시공사, 031-494-6200)
gg-ansan.bulky: Apply online, attach the certificate sticker (신고필증) and put it out. Pickup on Mon·Thu
gg-ansan.recyclingNotes: Recycling in clear or semi-clear plastic bags. Dirty items go in a pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투)

gg-hwaseong.name: Hwaseong-si
gg-hwaseong.days: 2–3 times a week depending on the area (recycling at least once a week). Find your collection company on the city's living-space web portal (생활공간 웹포털)
gg-hwaseong.place: Always in a standard bag (규격봉투), at the designated spot
gg-hwaseong.food: Drain as much water as possible, then put it in a standard bag (규격봉투) or collection bin
gg-hwaseong.bulky: Buy a sticker at a sales point, attach it and call the company, or apply via 'Bbegi' (빼기, bbegi.com)
gg-hwaseong.recyclingNotes: Unsorted waste is not collected. Clear PET bottles (투명페트병): remove the label, crush, put in a clear bag

gg-suwon.name: Suwon-si
gg-suwon.hours: Houses: in front of your home after 20:00. End time differs by district (Jangan-gu 03:00, Paldal-gu 05:00)
gg-suwon.days: No pickup on Sunday. Recycling on your neighborhood's pickup day
gg-suwon.place: Houses: in front of your own home (putting it out in the daytime counts as illegal dumping (무단투기))
gg-suwon.food: Houses: food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투) / Apartments: special collection bin
gg-suwon.bulky: Buy a sticker at a shop and attach it, or report online at waste.suwon.go.kr
gg-suwon.recyclingNotes: Bundle by item type, in clear plastic bags

gg-siheung.name: Siheung-si
gg-siheung.days: General, food and recycling: Sun–Fri / Clear PET bottles: Thu·Fri
gg-siheung.noPickupDay: Do not put it out on Saturday (no pickup on Sunday)
gg-siheung.place: In front of your own home or shop
gg-siheung.food: Yellow pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) or special bin (chip 칩) / RFID, with the water drained
gg-siheung.bags: Pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) sales points (supermarkets, convenience stores, etc.)
gg-siheung.bulky: Apply at waste.siheung.go.kr and attach the certificate sticker (신고필증), or use a sticker from a sales point
gg-siheung.recyclingNotes: There is a white bag (for burying, 묻는 용) and a pink bag (for burning, 태우는 용). Animal bones, shells and eggshells go in the general bag

gg-gimpo.name: Gimpo-si
gg-gimpo.days: Depends on the area. No pickup on Sunday
gg-gimpo.place: Designated disposal spot. Apartments: days set by the complex
gg-gimpo.bulky: Report online, then attach the sticker and put it out (from 2 days after applying)
gg-gimpo.recyclingNotes: White bag = general waste, yellow bag = special burnable waste (가연성 특수), white sack (흰 마대) = broken glass, etc.

gg-pyeongtaek.name: Pyeongtaek-si
gg-pyeongtaek.noPickupDay: No disposal from Saturday 04:00 to Sunday 20:00 (fine (과태료) of 100,000 won if you break this)
gg-pyeongtaek.place: Tie the pay-as-you-throw bag (종량제 봉투) and put it at the designated spot
gg-pyeongtaek.food: Remove water and other objects, put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투), then in the collection bin. Take out plastic, bottle caps, shells and tea bags
gg-pyeongtaek.bulky: Report online on the city website, attach the certificate (필증), and put it out at 20:00 the day before pickup
gg-pyeongtaek.recyclingNotes: Usable appliances and furniture: free pickup by the recycling center (재활용센터)

busan-jung.name: Jung-gu
busan-jung.days: Sun·Tue·Thu: general and food waste / Mon: cans, bottles, scrap metal, plastic, milk cartons, clear PET bottles / Wed: paper, clothes, plastic film, styrofoam
busan-jung.noPickupDay: No disposal on Friday or Saturday
busan-jung.place: In front of the gate of your home or shop
busan-jung.food: In a special food-waste bin with a payment sticker (납부필증, chip 칩), with the water drained
busan-jung.bulky: Report at the community center (동 주민센터) or via 'Yeogiro' (여기로, yeogiro24.co.kr) → attach the certificate sticker (신고필증) and put it out. Large appliances free: 1599-0903
busan-jung.recyclingNotes: Wash recycling and put it in clear plastic bags

gwangju-gwangsan.name: Gwangsan-gu
gwangju-gwangsan.hours: Food waste: 20:00 – 06:00 the next morning (not in the daytime)
gwangju-gwangsan.days: Food waste pickup: Mon–Sat. For general waste and recycling days, check with the district office (구청)
gwangju-gwangsan.noPickupDay: Food waste: no disposal on Saturday or the day before a public holiday
gwangju-gwangsan.place: In front of your own home or shop, on the evening before pickup
gwangju-gwangsan.food: In front of your home, spread over the days (do not put it all out at once on Sunday)
gwangju-gwangsan.bulky: 'Large waste' (대형폐기물) menu on the district office website

seoul-gwangjin.name: Gwangjin-gu
seoul-gwangjin.days: Sun·Mon·Tue·Wed·Thu·Fri (same for general waste, food waste and recycling; same in every neighborhood)
seoul-gwangjin.noPickupDay: Do not put waste out on Saturday or the day before a public holiday
seoul-gwangjin.place: Houses: in front of your own home / Apartments: the way your complex decides
seoul-gwangjin.food: Houses: put the purple food-waste bag in a food-waste bin, in front of your home (the bin is free at the community center (동주민센터))
seoul-gwangjin.bags: Shops that sell pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제 봉투). Household bags are white
seoul-gwangjin.bulky: smartclean-gwangjin.kr or the community center (동주민센터) → attach the certificate sticker (신고필증) and put it in front of your home
seoul-gwangjin.recyclingNotes: Put each type in a clear plastic bag; tie boxes and styrofoam together. Breaking the day, time or place rules: fine of 100,000 won

seoul-guro.name: Guro-gu
seoul-guro.days: Depends on the neighborhood: Sun·Tue·Thu or Mon·Wed·Fri (ask the Cleaning Administration Division (청소행정과): 02-860-2912)
seoul-guro.place: Houses and small shops: in front of your own home (shop) / Apartments: the complex's collection point
seoul-guro.food: Put it in a yellow food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투) and put out the bag itself
seoul-guro.bags: Shops chosen by the district office (구청). General waste: white bag, food waste: yellow bag
seoul-guro.bulky: Apply on the district office website, call center 02-2615-3203, community center (주민센터), or the 'Ppaegi' (빼기) app
seoul-guro.recyclingNotes: Plastic film/vinyl goes separately in its own special bag (if you have none, a clear bag)

seoul-seongdong.name: Seongdong-gu
seoul-seongdong.days: General and food waste: Mon·Wed·Fri or Tue·Thu·Sun, depending on the neighborhood / Recycling: Thursday is only for clear PET bottles and plastic film; everything else on Sun·Mon·Tue·Wed·Fri
seoul-seongdong.noPickupDay: Saturday is not a disposal day. Breaking this rule: fine of 100,000 won
seoul-seongdong.place: Houses and offices: always in front of the building / Apartments: the place set by the complex
seoul-seongdong.food: Houses: put it in a food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투), then in a food-waste bin, in front of your gate
seoul-seongdong.bags: Shops that sell pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제 봉투). As a rule, use Seongdong-gu bags
seoul-seongdong.bulky: 02-2248-1001, the district office website, or the 'Yeogiro' (여기로) app
seoul-seongdong.recyclingNotes: Collect bottles, cans and plastic in a clear bag; tie paper together

seoul-dongdaemun.name: Dongdaemun-gu
seoul-dongdaemun.days: Mon·Wed·Fri: Yongsin-dong, Jeonnong 2-dong, Dapsimni 1-dong, Jangan 2-dong, Hoegi-dong, Hwigyeong 1·2-dong / Sun·Tue·Thu: Jegi-dong, Jeonnong 1-dong, Dapsimni 2-dong, Jangan 1-dong, Cheongnyangni-dong, Imun 1·2-dong
seoul-dongdaemun.place: In front of your home (general waste, food waste and recycling, separated, put out together)
seoul-dongdaemun.food: Yellow food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투)
seoul-dongdaemun.bags: Shops that sell pay-as-you-throw bags (종량제 봉투). General waste: white, food waste: yellow
seoul-dongdaemun.bulky: 'Yeogiro' (여기로, yeogiro24.co.kr) or the community center (동주민센터) → attach the disposal number. Large appliances free: 1599-0903
seoul-dongdaemun.recyclingNotes: Mon·Wed·Fri neighborhoods: recycling Mon·Wed, plastic film and clear PET bottles Fri / Sun·Tue·Thu neighborhoods: recycling Sun·Tue, plastic film and clear PET bottles Thu

incheon-yeongjong.name: Yeongjong-gu
incheon-yeongjong.days: General waste: the day before pickup day. Food waste (houses): Unseo 1·2-dong Sun·Tue·Thu / Yeongjong-dong, Yeongjong 1·2-dong, Yongyu-dong Mon·Wed·Fri
incheon-yeongjong.place: In front of your own home or shop
incheon-yeongjong.food: Houses: in a food-waste bin with a payment sticker (납부필증) attached, in front of your home / Apartments: collection bins or RFID
incheon-yeongjong.bags: Designated shops. Old Jung-gu bags can also be used
incheon-yeongjong.bulky: 'Yeogiro' (여기로, yeogiro24.co.kr) or a sticker from a bag shop. Appliances free: 1599-0903
incheon-yeongjong.recyclingNotes: Since July 2026, the Yeongjong area of Jung-gu, Incheon is Yeongjong-gu (Yeongjongdo island, around Incheon Airport)

incheon-yeonsu.name: Yeonsu-gu
incheon-yeonsu.hours: On disposal days 18:00 – 04:00 the next morning
incheon-yeonsu.days: General waste: every day except Saturday / Food waste: Ongnyeon, Yeonsu Tue·Thu·Sun; Seonhak, Cheonghak, Dongchun Mon·Wed·Fri; Songdo every day except Saturday / Recycling: Ongnyeon, Yeonsu, Songdo 1·4·5 Tue·Thu·Sun; Cheonghak, Dongchun, Seonhak, Songdo 2·3 Mon·Wed·Fri
incheon-yeonsu.place: Houses and shops: in front of your building / Apartments: designated place / Songdo areas with an automatic waste collection system: into the inlet
incheon-yeonsu.food: Apartments: RFID / Houses and shops: food-waste bin + payment sticker (납부필증) / Songdo automatic collection areas: food-waste pay-as-you-throw bag (음식물 종량제 봉투)
incheon-yeonsu.bulky: Report online on the district office website, the 'Ppaegi' (빼기) app, 032-562-1008, or a sticker from a bag shop
incheon-yeonsu.recyclingNotes: Recycling goes in clear plastic bags. Bedding, rubber, etc. in the yellow bag; glass and ceramics in a sack (마대)
